record_title: Sharp centered critical-point power moments and parity-dependent extremizers
provenance: Sharp centered refinement of the reciprocal critical-point moment estimate appearing at the origin endpoint of Teng Zhang's arXiv:2609.19126.
limitations: Only the distinguished zero at the origin is covered. The stability theorem is radial and gives no angular stability. The general noncentral subquadratic Tang-Zhang range is not resolved. The most relevant older inaccessible source is Sheil-Small's Complex Polynomials, pp. 361-362; accessible secondary statements describe Smale-type critical-value bounds rather than the equality classification here. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
